data.exact_reserve_text: During 2015 the estimated ultimate loss ratio (net of acquisitions costs) on certain lines of business for the 2014 and prior years of account was increased. These increases are set out in the table below together with their effect on ultimate claims reserves.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Worse than expected claims experienced primarily in the US liability account leading to substantial reserve strengthening for 2013 and prior years of account.
Increase in estimated ultimate loss ratio for Personal Accident & Sickness leading to higher claims reserves.
Small increase in estimated ultimate loss ratio on Special Lines increasing claims reserves.

data.standardized_narrative: During 2015 the Syndicate materially strengthened prior years' gross claims reserves, principally reflecting adverse development in the US liability account. Movement in estimated ultimate loss ratios for certain prior years increased gross claims reserves by GBP 35.757m (11.1% of opening gross claims outstanding), with the bulk of the strengthening in Liability (Casualty), and smaller increases in Personal Accident & Sickness and Special Lines.
raw_causal_phrases: During 2015 the estimated ultimate loss ratio (net of acquisitions costs) on certain lines of business for the 2014 and prior years of account was increased.

The result was affected by worse than expected claims experienced primarily in the US liability account which is no longer written in that form and, as a result, significant amounts of Liability business has not been renewed into the 2014 or 2015 years of account.
During the second quarter of 2015 a detailed review was undertaken of this account and the reserves strengthened substantially for the 2013 and prior years of account.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Lines of business no longer written

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding and the prior year movement were taken from the Technical Provisions note (Note 18) and the Movement in prior year's provision note (Note 7) respectively. The prior year movement was computed as the sum of the explicit gross increases shown in Note 7. No specific named catastrophe events affecting prior years were listed. Page numbers are taken from the notes headings; if exact PDF pagination differs slightly, refer to Notes 7 and 18 in the financial statements.
